newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-PALLISTER OUT OF CUP CLASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PALLISTER OUT OF CUP CLASH.

text.p: England defender Gary Pallister was on Monday ruled out of Manchester United's next two games, including Sunday's FA Cup third round showdown with Tottenham Hotspur.
Pallister has missed most of United's recent matches with a recurrence of a back injury which plagued him last year.

Manchester United manager Alex Ferguson said: "Gary will miss the game against Aston Villa on New Year's Day and Sunday's Cup game against Tottenham. He is not making any progress so we will just have to be patient."
